title: Total Superset
description: Push-pull and squat-hinge supersets: incline push-ups, sumo squats and floor hip thrust

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.instructions: Step up and down alternating legs

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Floor face pulls
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull back

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide apart, toes pointed outward

exercises.name: Floor hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, lift hips, squeeze glutes

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower your head between your hands

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms by your sides, sweep them in an arc on the floor

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
